stanzas.loss_note: The translation renders 'नदियों का पार' as 'Across the streams' to fit the rhyme scheme, slightly altering the literal sense of crossing or reaching the other side of rivers.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation renders 'nadiyon ka paar' (literally 'the other side of the rivers' or 'crossing the rivers') as 'Across the streams' to fit the rhyme scheme, slightly altering the scale from rivers to streams.
The translation adds the verb 'gleams' to rhyme with 'streams', whereas the original Hindi simply states 'har boond mein pyaar' (literally 'love in every drop').

annotation.theme: The innocent joy and dreams of childhood symbolized by a paper boat in the rain

original_poem:
कागज की कश्ती,  
बारिश में बहती,  
बचपन की यादों में,  
खुशियों की बातें।  

सपनों का संसार,  
नदियों का पार,  
साथ मेरे दोस्त,  
हर बूँद में प्यार।
translated_poem:
A paper boat,  
Drifting in the rain,  
In the memories of childhood,  
Talking of joys again.  

A world of dreams,  
Across the streams,  
With my friends beside,  
In every drop, love gleams.
